name: Starter pack
summary: A white grid collage that lists the objects, clothes and habits of one type of person around a cut-out figure. It grew from Tumblr and Twitter in 2014 and became a general template for identity jokes.

philosophy.core_thesis: Describe a type of person as a kit of things you can buy, wear and say.
design_principles: Divide a white canvas of 600px x 750px into a 3 x 3 grid of product cut-outs with 12px gutters.
Place a figure or a name label in the centre cell and put 5 to 8 object photos around it.
Cut each object out with a clean edge on a white ground, with no shadow.
Add a bold title at the top: "<Type> starter pack" in 40px black type.
Add a 14px caption under each object, in sentence case, with a brand or a habit.
Keep the object sizes within 20% of each other; the figure may be 1.5 times larger.
Use plain white for the ground and keep all photos in their own colours.
anti_patterns: Soft overlapping layouts with no grid
Real private persons as the figure
Abstract objects with no real product

layout.grid_mechanics: A 3-column grid with 12px gutters on a 600px wide canvas; the centre cell holds the figure.
layout.whitespace_ratio: White ground fills 100% of the canvas; objects take 60% and text 15%.
layout.alignment_rules: Objects sit centred in their cells; captions align centre under each object.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular cells with a 0px radius and no borders.

font_pairings.note: A clean bold sans for the title and a plain sans for captions.
A geometric pair that suits a product grid.

hierarchy_rules: Use two sizes: 40px for the title and 14px for captions.
Use bold (700) for the title and regular (400) for captions.
Use black text on white; no other colour.

color.palette_structure: White ground, black text; the colour comes from the product photos.
color.contrast_rules: Black on white gives 18:1; caption grey #555555 on white gives 7.5:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat white; photos keep their own colour and light.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft studio light on each cut-out; no shadow on the ground.

materiality.surface_simulation: A product catalogue page of cut-out photos.
materiality.border_rules: No borders; the gutters are white space.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; the objects serve as icons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Cut-out product photos and brand logos on white.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A web version pops each object in 120ms apart.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales an object by 4% and shows its caption in black.

emotion.target_response: The viewer sees themselves or a friend in the kit and laughs with recognition.

avoid_when: The subject is a real private person.
The jokes stereotype a protected group.

modifiers.how: Replace photos with flat icons in 4 colours and keep the 3 x 3 grid.
Overlap the objects, add tape and tilt them by 2 to 4 degrees.
Replace the objects with a single post card and a short joke.

pack.why: A solid object family that reads as a catalogue of small products.

ground.why: Evenly sized blocks echo the cells of a catalogue grid.
